supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42 UTC, WS-ARUIZ-01 recorded a network logon by raj.patel from 10.51.10.23, which the inventory identifies as WS-RPATEL-01; the logon was assigned privileged rights.

At 13:44 UTC, raj.patel ran PowerShell with the exact inventory-listed patch script path, \\FILE-PIN-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1. The process ran under the raj.patel logon and launched wusa to install a Windows update package; this matches the stated IT patching practice.
The recorded PowerShell process started at 13:44:13 UTC and ended at 13:44:23 UTC, consistent with a brief appearance, though several minutes later than the reported approximate time.
The supplied records around 13:40 show Kerberos activity and an SMB connection from WS-ARUIZ-01 to DC-PIN-01, but do not show a PowerShell process at that time.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not show the workstation display or establish exactly when a user-visible PowerShell window appeared.
The process records show the PowerShell command line and child installer, but do not include the contents or hash of Patch-Workstations.ps1.
The proxy record shows an attempted connection to download.windowsupdate.com was denied; the supplied records do not establish the provenance of the installed update package.
claims_not_established: That the reported window appeared at precisely 13:40 UTC, rather than around that time.
That the 13:44 PowerShell process was the exact window ana.ruiz noticed.
That the patch script's contents were benign solely from its path and command line.
unrelated_findings: A Dropbox updater ran as SYSTEM on WS-ARUIZ-01; Dropbox is not among the approved software and services in the supplied inventory. Review separately; it does not determine this alert. (T064-00245, T064-00246, T064-00247, T064-00248)

WS-ARUIZ-01 made TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443, with svchost recorded as the initiating process. The supplied evidence does not establish the purpose of these connections; review separately. (T064-00085, T064-00086, T064-00091, T064-00088, T064-00090)
